assign_despot_desc.en: Assign a [character|e] in the position of $STATIC_MODIFIER_NAME_despot_modifier$, with the following effects:\n[ShowModifierEffect('despot_modifier')]

assign_despot_desc_specific.en: Assign a [character|e] to the position of $STATIC_MODIFIER_NAME_despot_modifier$, giving them the [ShowModifier('despot_modifier')] [modifier|e].

blind_character_act_past.en: [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] has been blinded by imperial order

blind_character_desc.en: Order the blinding of a [character|e] at our court. This ancient punishment renders the target unable to lead armies and diminishes their political standing.

blind_character_desc_specific.en: Order the blinding of a [character|e], granting them the [ShowTraitName('blind')] condition.

blind_character_past.en: [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] has been blinded by imperial order

blind_new_pretender_emerges_tt.en: The conspiracy rallies behind a new claimant: [SCOPE.sCharacter('new_pretender_scope').GetName]

blind_pretender_removed_tt.en: [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] forfeits [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetHerHis] claim to the throne, as a blinded heir cannot rule

castrate_character_act_past.en: [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] has been castrated by imperial order

castrate_character_desc.en: Order the castration of a [character|e] at our court. This punishment marks the target permanently and removes their ability to sire children.

castrate_character_desc_specific.en: Order the castration of a [character|e], granting them the [ShowTraitName('castrated')] condition.

castrate_character_past.en: [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] has been castrated by imperial order

compose_strategikon_act_past.en: [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetName] has composed a Stratēgikòn, gaining a powerful [modifier|e] for [SCOPE.sCharacter('recipient').GetHerHis] reign.

compose_strategikon_desc.en: Our [ruler|e] will concentrate personal military expertise on a topic of war of choice. Such knowledge will surely help promote our prowess and exalt our famed martial capabilities.

compose_strategikon_desc_specific.en: Our [ruler|e] will gain an appropriate [character_modifier|e] depending on their composition.

has_not_composed_strategikon_tt.en: Our [ruler|e] has not already composed a Stratēgikòn in their lifetime
